channel.title: AgentUpdate.ai - AI Agent News & Tutorials
channel.description: The latest news, product updates, and in-depth tutorials on AI coding agents and autonomous workflows.

item.title: Solving Agent Amnesia: OKF Brings Portable Memory to Claude Code
item.description: Tired of AI agents forgetting your codebase context every session? Open Knowledge Format (OKF) offers a structured, git-friendly, and vendor-neutral Markdown memory system for Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agents to share knowledge seamlessly.

item.title: Google Caps Meta's Gemini Access Amid Severe AI Compute Shortage
item.description: Google has capped Meta's access to its Gemini AI models due to compute constraints. The restriction has forced Meta to optimize token usage and accelerate its shift to 'Muse Spark,' an internal model, highlighting the acute infrastructure bottleneck facing tech giants.

item.title: Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR: Continuous Document Parsing Beats DeepSeek
item.description: Baidu has open-sourced Unlimited OCR, a novel model designed to parse dozens of pages continuously. Utilizing Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), it maintains a constant KV cache, solving memory bloat and outperforming DeepSeek OCR.

item.title: DeepSeek Releases DSpark: Speculative Decoding Boosts Generation Speed by Up to 85%
item.description: DeepSeek, in collaboration with Peking University, has released DSpark, a speculative decoding framework that boosts single-user generation speed by up to 85%. By combining a semi-autoregressive architecture with confidence-scheduled verification, it significantly accelerates LLM inference.

item.title: [Blog] Seamless Remote Access in China: A Portable Gateway Solution Using GL-MT3000, HomeProxy, and Mobile Hotspot
item.description: A practical, portable gateway-level network solution for remote professionals traveling back to China. By leveraging the GL-iNet GL-MT3000 router tethered to a mobile hotspot, HomeProxy (Sing-box) in TUN mode, and a WebSocket-based remote node, you can set up a client-free transparent proxy that bypasses local DNS pollution.

item.title: [Blog] Run a Full-Stack SaaS Solo: Cloudflare is the Ultimate Foundation for One-Person Companies (From $5/mo)
item.description: For one-person companies and indie hackers, Cloudflare is the ultimate cost-performance stack: $5/mo Workers, free Pages, global edge network, D1 database, KV/R2 storage, edge caching, and built-in Workers AI. Using a real-world multilingual SaaS case study and mermaid architecture diagrams, we break down why it's powerful and where the pitfalls lie.

item.title: [Blog] From Classic SEO to AI-Native GEO: How We Used Claude Code Skills to Automate and Optimize AgentUpdate.ai
item.description: A detailed, step-by-step case study showing how we utilized Claude Code's seo-audit-full and geo-content-optimizer skills to automate technical SEO audits and GEO optimization for AgentUpdate.ai, with before-and-after code and score comparisons for each step.

item.title: Agibot Spin-off Valued at $1B; DeepSeek to Double Headcount as Embodied AI Surges
item.description: Agibot's robotic hand spin-off, Critical Point, has achieved a $1 billion valuation within five months of launching, achieving first-quarter profitability. Concurrently, AI pioneer DeepSeek has planned to double its headcount across all departments. The embodied AI landscape in China continues to scale rapidly, with the overall market size projected to surpass 1 trillion RMB by 2026.

item.title: Claude Fable 5 Reappears in Grayscale Test as OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Leaks
item.description: Anthropic's powerhouse model, Claude Fable 5, has reportedly resurfaced in limited gray tests on Claude Code and AWS, despite official claims of a UI bug. Rumors suggest this follows successful government negotiations led by co-founder Tom Brown. In response, OpenAI's GPT-5.6 has also leaked on internal paths, signaling a new era of staged, batch releases mandated by US regulatory frameworks.

item.title: Trump Administration Demands OpenAI Stagger GPT-5.6 Release Over Security Concerns
item.description: Due to cybersecurity concerns, the Trump administration has requested OpenAI to stagger the release of its upcoming GPT-5.6 model, requiring case-by-case federal approval for customer access during the preview phase.

item.title: Baidu Smart Cloud Launches Qianfan Token Plan Enterprise: Unified AI Resource Ops
item.description: Baidu Smart Cloud has launched the Qianfan Token Plan Enterprise Edition, an enterprise-level AI subscription service. It addresses challenges like fragmented AI tool procurement and unpredictable costs by providing unified management and flexible access to leading large models such as GLM-5.2. Utilizing a "seat-based + shared credit package" model, it enables businesses to efficiently integrate AI capabilities and AI Agent tools into their workflows with clear budgetary control and enhanced operational efficiency.

item.title: Alibaba QoderWork Launches 'Off-Peak Tokens' with up to 80% Off Qwen 3.7
item.description: Alibaba's QoderWork has launched China's first 'Off-Peak Tokens' pricing model. Agents running between 22:00 and 08:00 daily will enjoy significant discounts, with Qwen3.7-Max priced as low as 80% off. Perfect for developers running long-term scheduled tasks overnight.

item.title: MiniMax M3: The Sparse Attention Breakthrough Driving 1M-Token Context
item.description: Shanghai-based MiniMax has released M3, a groundbreaking open-weight model combining a 1M context window, native multimodal capabilities, and elite coding skills. Enabled by MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), it slashes compute by 28.4x.

item.title: AWS Empowers XPeng and Kimi to Drive AI Agent Production Readiness
item.description: At the AWS Summit, XPeng showcased its 'Lingxi' Agent platform built on Amazon Bedrock and EKS, compressing bug-fixing times from two days to ten minutes. Meanwhile, Moonshot AI (Kimi) is leveraging AWS's global infrastructure, SageMaker, and Bedrock to expand its LLM services globally. These cases highlight the shift of AI Agents from simple productivity assistants to highly capable digital workforces in production environments.

item.title: Anthropic's Government Feud: Three Key Trends to Watch
item.description: Following the US government's sudden export controls on Anthropic's coding-capable models Mythos and Fable, a new era of AI regulation has begun. This sudden intervention, sparked partly by competitor warnings, is driving global developers toward unrestricted Chinese open-source alternatives.

item.title: OpenAI Launches 'Patch the Planet' to Tackle Open-Source Bugs
item.description: OpenAI has launched "Patch the Planet" in partnership with Trail of Bits to help open-source maintainers leverage AI for vulnerability patching, addressing the deluge of AI-generated bug reports.

item.title: GLM-5.2 Released: The Ultimate Game-Changer for Open AI Agents
item.description: Z.ai has officially released GLM-5.2, an open-weight model licensed under MIT. Powered by the SLIME RL framework and specialized 'thinking effort' modes, GLM-5.2 matches top-tier closed-source models from OpenAI and Anthropic on Agent leaderboards, sparking a major shift in the open-source AI Agent ecosystem.

item.title: Building an OpenAI-Compatible Gateway for AWS Bedrock
item.description: Developers want to use AWS Bedrock in tools like Cursor and Continue, but API mismatches and security constraints pose a challenge. Learn how to build a lightweight gateway that bridges OpenAI's API with Bedrock, securing IAM keys and tracking costs.

item.title: How Anthropic's Cybersecurity Model Mythos Triggered a US Export Ban
item.description: Anthropic's positioning of its cybersecurity-focused model, Mythos, has backfired, resulting in a US export ban. The incident highlights growing friction between advanced AI labs, national security agencies, and global technology regulations.

item.title: Getty Images Partners with OpenAI, Sending Stock Soaring Over 200%
item.description: Getty Images has entered a landmark multi-year partnership with OpenAI to integrate its licensed visual library into ChatGPT search. The news caused Getty's stock to skyrocket by over 200% in premarket trading, marking a major shift from copyright litigation to compliance cooperation.

item.title: Anthropic to Require Identity Verification via Persona for Key Claude Features
item.description: Anthropic has announced that starting July 2026, certain Claude features will require third-party identity verification powered by Persona. While aimed at enhancing security, Persona's controversial history with data breaches and user backlash raises critical questions about privacy and autonomous AI agent operations.
